SellerGuide.title: Seller Guide
SellerGuide.subtitle: Everything you need to know to sell successfully on Maison Sale

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.body: Sign up for a free account and complete your profile. Add a profile photo and bio to build trust with buyers. You'll need to verify your phone number and email before listing your first item.

listing.title: Listing Your Item
listing.body: Go to + Sell in the navigation. Choose your category and sub-category, then fill in the item details. The more information you provide, the faster your item will sell.

photos.title: Photos & Condition
photos.body: Use natural light and a clean background. Take at least 5 photos including front, back, close-ups of any defects, and tags or labels. Honest condition descriptions build trust and reduce returns.

pricingTips.title: Pricing Tips
pricingTips.body: Research similar sold items to price competitively. Enable "Open to Negotiation" if you're flexible. Auction mode works well for high-demand or rare items.

gettingPaid.title: Getting Paid
gettingPaid.body: Maison Sale charges a {percent}% platform fee when your item sells. Your earnings are credited to your wallet as soon as the delivery is confirmed, and you can withdraw to your bank account at any time — transfers take 1–3 business days.

Help.title: Help Center
Help.subtitle: How can we help you today?

authentic.q: How do I know if an item is authentic?
authentic.a: All sellers are verified by our team. Items over SAR 5,000 go through our Riyadh Hub for authentication before delivery.

wrongItem.q: What happens if I receive a wrong or fake item?
wrongItem.a: You are fully protected. Report within 48 hours and receive a full refund. Your money is held in escrow until you confirm delivery.

trade.q: How does the Trade feature work?
trade.a: Select an item you want, choose "Offer Trade", then pick your item to trade. Both ship to our Riyadh Hub for inspection, then are exchanged.

cancel.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it?
cancel.a: Regular orders can be cancelled within 1 hour. Auction wins and Trade agreements cannot be cancelled after confirmation.

shipping.a: Standard: 3–5 business days. Express: 1–2 business days. Riyadh Hub items add 2–4 days for authentication.

payment.a: Mada, STC Pay, Tabby, Tamara, PayTabs, Apple Pay and cards (Visa, Mastercard). All transactions are secured and encrypted, and sellers pay a {percent}% platform fee on each sale.

Help.sent: Thanks — your message is with our support team.

errors.requestFailed: That didn't go through. Please try again.

window.title: 14-Day Return Window
window.body: You have 14 days from delivery to request a return. Items must be in the same condition as received. Report issues within 48 hours of delivery.

eligible.title: Eligible for Return
eligible.body: Item not as described · Counterfeit or fake item · Wrong item received · Item arrived damaged · Seller misrepresented condition

notEligible.title: Not Eligible for Return
notEligible.body: Change of mind · Size issues (check the size guide before buying) · Items marked "Final Sale" · Auction items (unless not as described)

refund.title: Refund Timeline
refund.body: Approved refunds are processed within 3–5 business days to your original payment method or your Maison Sale wallet.

howTo.title: How to Request a Return
howTo.body: Go to My Orders → select the order → Request Return → choose a reason → upload photos if needed → submit. Our team reviews within 24 hours.

payment.title: Payment Methods & Security
payment.securityBody: All transactions are secured with SSL encryption. Your payment details are never stored on our servers. We use PCI DSS compliant payment gateways. Funds are held in escrow until you confirm delivery.
